negatives/ci-workflow.yaml.text:
ci-workflow > node-1

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

ci-workflow > node-2

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

ci-workflow > node-4

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: [18, 20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test -- --reporter junit --outputFile reports/junit-${{ matrix.node }}.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-${{ matrix.node }}
          path: reports/
  package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/

negatives/docker-compose.yaml.text:
docker-compose > node-0

services:
  web:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://app:app@db:5432/storefront
      REDIS_URL: redis://cache:6379/0
      NODE_ENV: development
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      cache:
        condition: service_started
    volumes:
      - ./src:/app/src:cached
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: app
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: app
      POSTGRES_DB: storefront
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U app -d storefront"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
  cache:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    command: ["redis-server", "--maxmemory", "128mb", "--maxmemory-policy", "allkeys-lru"]
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
  mailhog:
    image: mailhog/mailhog:v1.0.1
    ports:
      - "8025:8025"

negatives/k8s-deployment.yaml.text:
k8s-deployment > node-2

items:
  - apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    metadata:
      name: storefront-web
      namespace: retail
      labels:
        app: storefront-web
        tier: frontend
    spec:
      replicas: 3
      revisionHistoryLimit: 5
      selector:
        matchLabels:
          app: storefront-web
      strategy:
        type: RollingUpdate
        rollingUpdate:
          maxSurge: 1
          maxUnavailable: 0
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app: storefront-web
            tier: frontend
          annotations:
            prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
            prometheus.io/port: "9102"
        spec:
          serviceAccountName: storefront-web
          containers:
            - name: web
              image: registry.example.com/retail/storefront-web:1.42.7
              ports:
                - name: http
                  containerPort: 8080
              env:
                - name: NODE_ENV
                  value: production
                - name: SESSION_REDIS_HOST
                  valueFrom:
                    configMapKeyRef:
                      name: storefront-config
                      key: redisHost
              resources:
                requests:
                  cpu: 250m
                  memory: 256Mi
                limits:
                  cpu: "1"
                  memory: 512Mi
              readinessProbe:
                httpGet:
                  path: /healthz/ready

k8s-deployment > node-2

                  port: http
                initialDelaySeconds: 5
                periodSeconds: 10
              livenessProbe:
                httpGet:
                  path: /healthz/live
                  port: http
                initialDelaySeconds: 15
                periodSeconds: 20
  - apiVersion: v1
    kind: Service
    metadata:
      name: storefront-web
      namespace: retail
    spec:
      type: ClusterIP
      selector:
        app: storefront-web
      ports:
        - name: http
          port: 80
          targetPort: http

    "declarationMap": true,
    "sourceMap": true,
    "incremental": true,
